label: NETGEAR Nighthawk AC1900 cable modem router (C7000)
description: Two-in-one DOCSIS 3.0 24x8 cable modem and 4-port gigabit router with dual-band 802.11ac Wi-Fi, all behind one coax F-connector.
notes: Datasheet (C7000v2): '24 downstream & 8 upstream channels' DOCSIS 3.0 bonding (960 Mbps DS class), 'Four (4) 10/100/1000 Mbps (4 LAN) Gigabit Ethernet ports', IEEE 802.11 b/g/n 2.4 GHz + 802.11 a/n/ac 5 GHz. The single USB 2.0 port is excluded per batch rule. Unlike the plain modems this one carries the full routed stack: NAT, SPI firewall, DHCP server, web UI.
